notes: Melvin is printed 'MELVIN (DONNERSBERGER)'. Zachary is the 20 ft street east of Carr near the bottom (named on sheet 37 'ZACHARY (TAYLOR)'). West 8th: only the south block face is on the sheet (y~337-348); the street is labelled 60', so the centreline is computed 101 px north of the face (y~236-247); the two double-dashed lines at y~272/312 are water pipes, not the centreline. West 7th exists only west of Harriet (50 ft, T at Harriet from the west) and again east of Carr (60 ft per sheet 37, T at Carr from the east); the blocks between Harriet and Carr run through from 8th to Budd. Harriet/Budd is an offset crossing: Harriet north of Budd is 50 ft centred x~1986, south of Budd it is a 30 ft street centred x~1923; Budd west of Harriet is centred y~1783, east of it y~1833. The point given is the middle of the four block corners (1902,1700)/(2070,1750)/(1867,1866)/(1980,1917); each centreline passes within ~35 px of it. Harriet south of Budd ends at the rail trestle; a separate 40 ft section of Harriet, centred x~1666 (well west of the northern line), runs from the yard edge to West 6th and continues south on sheet 18. West 6th is labelled 66 (rotated); only its north face is on the sheet (y~4434-4440) so the centre is computed 111 px south of it (near the lower water pipe line). Carr and Harriet continue south of 6th on sheet 18, Melvin/Carr/Harriet continue north of 8th on sheet 48. Deming Alley width printed 10'.
